versions.subject: New/Update LOLBIN Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\Adplus.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Adplus.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Dump process memory
        - ' -hang '
        - ' -pn '
        - ' -pmn '
        - ' -p '
        - ' -po '
        # Using a config file
        - ' -c '
        # Execute commands inline
        - ' -sc '
condition: all of selection*
